title: fix(console): a shared view's draft save keeps the list on the draft, and a second change builds on the first
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuVwX4pUdM1qvNLSqRZNSvv3)_
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgW85kwjGaz7HqsmEuv

Fixes #35932
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — console runtime behaviour only; no authorable key, value or published skill text changes

## 维护者速读

- 管理员改共享视图(选页脚汇总、改视图设置)保存草稿后,列表不再闪回已发布版本,一直显示草稿,直到发布;其他用户照旧只看已发布版本。
- 属于列表页重做那一组工作:先前连选两次汇总再发布,只留下第二次,这里两次都保住。
- 出错时列表又会在保存后闪一下骨架屏、回到已发布版本;改动只在控制台前端,撤回此合并即恢复原样。
- 无。

## What changes

**Measured cause (not the one the card first guessed at, one layer further down).** `persistRuntimeMetadata` does emit the metadata-refresh pulse on every draft save, and `MetadataProvider` does refetch every loaded type on it, as the card says. The remount itself comes from what the route reads while that refetch is on the wire: the type cache sets the view list to `loading`, and `viewsForObjects` counted only `ready`/`error` as answered, so the route's object scope read `settled: false`, `AppContent`'s `routeReadsSettled` went false, the route slot dropped to its skeleton, and `ObjectView` mounted again. The new mount lost its `viewDraft` state and read the published view. Measured with a throwaway probe on the real `MetadataProvider` + `AppContent` (base `ec243639`): holding the refetched `/meta/view` list sent the route to the skeleton and the route element mounted twice; holding the by-name object reads, or holding nothing, did not.

- `MetadataProvider`: a type entry carries `answered` (set when a fetch settles, cleared only when the entry drops its items: whole-type `invalidate`, an organization switch). A type refetching in place over an answer it still holds counts as answered (`typeAnswered`), so a scope stays settled on the views in hand. This is what `refreshScopes` ("Refetch every scope in place: the items stay until the answers replace them") and `AppContent`'s `useLazyMetadataSettled` ("A bucket that answered once and is now refetching keeps its items while it loads, so it still counts") already said; the view half of the scope did not do it. The pulse's meaning to its subscribers (chat, marketplace, Studio, pending drafts) is unchanged: they are still told, and still refetch. The provider's refresh contract is unchanged; one reader-facing readiness answer during a refresh changed.
- `objectViewViewCrud.tsx` / `ObjectView.tsx`: the list no longer remounts on a draft save, so the local draft copy is no longer dropped by a remount either. The view settings draft bar's Publish and Discard (`onAfterChange`) now go through `handleDraftBarChange`, which bumps the refresh counter and drops `viewDraft` once the saved views have been read again (not before, so the list does not fall back to the pre-publish read). Before this change Discard relied on the remount to clear the discarded draft from the screen. `ObjectView.tsx` changes two lines (the destructure and the `onAfterChange` prop).
- `MetadataProvider`, the app-bundle path (the one the showcase takes, measured in the browser): the pulse's `clearCache()` also drops the adapter's app bundle (`AppBundleStore.clear()`), and the bundle then answers `pending` until it is downloaded again. On a bundle-first route the view list type is never loaded, so `viewsForObjects` answered `NO_VIEWS`, not settled, and the route went to its skeleton all the same. The provider now keeps the items of the last bundle that answered in this world (`answeredBundleRef`, written on every `ready` peek), and while a reload is pending `viewsForObjects` answers from them, settled, when they hold every asked object. An asked object outside them still waits for the reload, as before (no `/meta/view` list read is started for it). An organization or session switch (`dropAdapterWorld`) forgets them. The refresh contract is unchanged: `clearCache`, the pulse, and what `peekAppBundle` readers see are as they were.
- Reports: `ReportView`'s draft save takes the same seam and the same pulse; its route reads the `report` bucket, which was already sticky, so nothing there changes beyond the scope no longer unsettling.

`emitMetadataRefresh` on a draft save is kept: the pending-drafts surfaces read on it (objectui#13139), and removing it would need a new ledger-only signal.

## Tests

- New `console/__tests__/AppContent.draftSaveKeepsList-35932.test.tsx`: real `AuthProvider`, `MetadataProvider`, `AppContent`, `ObjectView` and persistence seam; only the network is stubbed (the provider adapter with the refetched view list held open, the list's data source, the metadata client's `save`); `ListView` is a recording stand-in that counts mounts.
  - acceptance 1: an admin's footer pick, while the refresh is on the wire and after it lands: no skeleton, one mount, the pick drawn;
  - acceptance 3: two successive picks (Sum on `amount`, Latest on `closed_at`): two draft saves, the second body carries both;
  - acceptance 2: the writes are draft saves; a reader (not an admin) served the published view draws it without the admin's calculation and is offered no pick;
  - CONTROL: a whole-type `invalidate('view')` still sends the route to the skeleton.
  - The same on an app with a bundle: the provider's adapter has `peekAppBundle`, the pulse's `clearCache()` drops the bundle as `AppBundleStore.clear()` does, and its reload is held on the wire. A footer pick: no skeleton, one mount, the pick drawn, while the reload is held and after it lands. Two picks then Publish (through the seam the draft bar calls): the second draft carries both, and the Publish pulse keeps one mount and no skeleton. CONTROLS: a first entry held on the wire (no bundle has answered yet) does not draw the list until it lands, and a whole-type `invalidate('object')` on the bundle route still shows the skeleton.
  - Why the first version of this pin missed the bundle path: its adapter had no `peekAppBundle`, so it only ever exercised the no-bundle path.
- New `views/objectViewViewCrud.draftBarChange-35932.test.tsx`: Publish or Discard bumps the counter and drops the draft copy in the commit that installs the next saved-views read, and only that one; CONTROL: a read with no Publish or Discard keeps it.

## Acceptance notes

- **Side effect (accepted by the seat):** after a Publish (draft bar, chat card, Studio), a package install, or a metadata change noticed from another tab, the console route also stays mounted now, where it used to flash its skeleton and remount. The other pulses get the same change, which is what ui/AGENTS.md commandment eight asks ("refresh data, don't rebuild UI").
- A draft save still makes every mounted `MetadataProvider` refetch all its loaded types (one pulse, about ten reads), as before; only the remount is gone. Narrowing that needs a ledger-only signal and is not done here.
- **Side effect of the bundle half:** while a reloaded bundle is on the wire, the route shows the views of the bundle that last answered (the published views as of before the pulse). The ObjectView draft overlay keeps the admin's draft on screen meanwhile, and the list shows the new answer once it lands.
- Overlap: `overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD` merges cleanly with origin/main and with #36026 and #36024; it conflicts with #36037 in `ObjectView.tsx` on one prop line (this PR's `onAfterChange={handleDraftBarChange}` beside #36037's new `readOnly` prop next to the old `onAfterChange`). The resolution keeps both lines.

## Verification

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/__tests__/AppContent.draftSaveKeepsList-35932.test.tsx` should print `Tests  8 passed (8)`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx`: `answeredBundleRef` (written in `peekBundle`, forgotten in `dropAdapterWorld`) and its use in `viewsForObjects`; then `typeAnswered`, the `answered` lifecycle (set in `ensureOwnType`'s two settle arms and the session seed, cleared in whole-type `invalidate`), and the three `viewsForObjects` / whole-registry `settled` answers.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewViewCrud.tsx`: `handleDraftBarChange` and its `[savedViews]` effect.
3. The new AppContent pin.

Readings on final head `7001680d` (the bundle-path fix `1a98520d` and its changeset, on the merge of origin/main `c00be39b`, `397893e5`), repository objectstack-ai/objectstack. The first round's readings, on `59e9e7c5`, are kept below where they still stand.

<details><summary>Ablation, bundle half (the answered-bundle branch removed, the AppContent pin re-run)</summary>

With `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on `MetadataProvider.tsx`: the anchor (the `answered && asked.every(...) ? answered : null` arm of `viewsForObjects`) went from 1 hit to 0, the marker from 0 to 1, and the blob from the HEAD blob `00739af7` to `de6251bf`. The pin then read `Tests  2 failed | 6 passed (8)`: the two new bundle cases (the footer pick, and two picks then Publish) failed, and the no-bundle cases and the controls held. On restore the blob was `00739af7` again, equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` was empty. A first try was refused by the tool before running anything: its replacement text already occurred in the file, so the marker count could not move. That try ran nothing and counts for nothing.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation, first round (the MetadataProvider half put back to base, the pin's no-bundle cases re-run, on `59e9e7c5`)</summary>

`MetadataProvider.tsx` restored to base `ec243639`: the pin read `Tests  2 failed | 2 passed (4)`, with the footer-pick case and the two-picks case red and the reader case and the control green. The file was then restored to HEAD.
</details>

<details><summary>Affected suites</summary>

- `pnpm exec vitest run --root . --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/` (all of app-shell, run from `ui/`): `Test Files  2360 passed | 1 skipped (2361)`, `Tests  22118 passed | 9 skipped (22127)`, exit 0.
- `pnpm run type-check` in app-shell (src and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 scripts/` (derived): `Test Files  172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`, `Tests  5111 passed | 2 skipped (5113)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
- The two 35932 pins: `Tests  8 passed (8)` and `Tests  2 passed (2)`.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gate families</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on `7001680d`: 38 families, each run, each exit 0. `check:type-check-debt` was first NOT MEASURED (queue-timeout 99 behind this card's own suite run) and then re-run under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0. `--ran` with the codes recorded: "38 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)". `overlap-check.mjs --branch=HEAD`: clean with origin/main `96b66ca9`, #36026 and #36024; one conflict with #36037 (see Acceptance notes). Every other family is CI's.
</details>

<details><summary>Browser reading on the showcase stack (round 2, on the bundle-path fix)</summary>

Setup: a showcase backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin`, OS_PORT 4617) and the Console Vite dev server (:5617, `--strictPort`) serving app-shell src at `1a98520d`. The view `showcase_project.seat_r2` was freshly created and published with no calculations. Every `/api/v1/meta/view` request and every app-bundle request (`/api/v1/meta/app/APP/bundle`) was held 1500 ms. The route skeleton and a remount were detected by a DOM probe sampled on every mutation and every animation frame, as the AppContent pin does. Screenshots are at deviceScaleFactor 2 in `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35932/` (the `r2-` files).

- (1) Admin, first footer pick (Sum on budget): no skeleton, 0 remounts, 1 bundle reload and 1 view read on the wire. The footer drew `Sum $1,090,000.00`; the server draft held `budget: sum`.
- (1) Second change (Latest on start_date): no skeleton, 0 remounts. Footers `Sum $1,090,000.00` and `Latest Dec 5`; the server draft held `budget: sum, start_date: max`, and published nothing yet.
- (2) Publish from the view-settings draft bar: no skeleton, 0 remounts, 1 bundle reload. The published view held `budget: sum, start_date: max`, the draft was gone (404), and the footers stayed drawn.
- (3) CONTROL A: a whole-type `invalidate('object')` on the mounted provider showed the skeleton once and remounted once.
- (3) CONTROL B, the bundle path: a fresh open with the bundle held 4000 ms. The list was first drawn 1018 ms after the bundle answer was released (5019 ms after it was asked), so nothing was drawn while no bundle had answered.
- (4) A second user who is not an admin: before Publish, empty footers, no picker offered, and the published view held no calculation. After Publish, on a fresh open, both footers were drawn (`Sum $1,090,000.00`, `Latest Dec 5`).

Round 1 (on `59e9e7c5`, before the bundle half) measured the defect this round fixes: the first pick showed the skeleton and remounted, the second draft overwrote the first, and Publish remounted. Its screenshots are the files without the `r2-` prefix. Its reader case was NOT MEASURED because the reading script had the reader's password wrong.
</details>
